name: temple_of_enlightenment_scry_top_keeps_order_then_taps_for_u
notes: Pa628282112 G4. Printed: 'When this land enters, scry 1.' and '{T}: Add {W} or {U}.' Answering 'top' leaves seat 0's library order as it was. On seat 0's next turn the Temple has untapped; tapping it for its second option adds exactly {U}.
